(n - r - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    size_t localRows() const { return rowsOn(rank); }\n    // Global index of local row t\n    size_t globalRow(size_t t) const { return static_cast<size_t>(rank) + t * size; }\n};\n\n// Calls visit(block, src, count) once for the rows of every rank. Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. For column j, the owner of row j finishes\n// L[j][j] and broadcasts row j of L; every rank then updates its own rows below the\n// diagonal. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += rowj[k] * rowj[k];\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            double* row = &local[t * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / ljj;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        double* row = &local[t * n];\n        for (size_t j = layout.globalRow(t) + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix, distributed by rows\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    // Every rank walks the same random sequence but keeps only the rows of B it owns\n    std::vector<double> B(nLocal * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double value = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        const size_t row = i / n;\n        if (row % P == me) {\n            B[(row / P) * n + i % n] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for owned rows, with every block of B passing by this double* bi = &B[t * n];\n            double* ai = &local[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const double* bj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                ai[static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P] = sum;\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        local[t * n + layout.globalRow(t)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    // Compare owned rows of L * L^T with the original matrix, with every block of L passing by\n    forEachRowBlock(L, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* li = &L[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P;\n Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. For column j, the owner of row j finishes\n// L[j][j] and broadcasts row j of L; every rank then updates its own rows below the\n// diagonal. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += rowj[k] * rowj[k];\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n {\n        double* row = &local[t * n];\n        for (size_t j = layout.globalRow(t) + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix, distributed by rows\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(rowj[k], rowj[k], sum);\n            }","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition (MPI, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Rows are distributed cyclically: global row i is owned by rank i % size and is\n// stored locally as row i / size. Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? The block holds the\n// `count` rows owned by rank `src`, row-major. Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. For column j, the owner of row j finishes\n// L[j][j] and broadcasts row j of L; every rank then updates its own rows below the\n// diagonal. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += rowj[k] * rowj[k];\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            double* row = &local[t * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / ljj;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        double* row = &local[t * n];\n        for (size_t j = layout.globalRow(t) + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix, distributed by rows\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    // Every rank walks the same random sequence but keeps only the rows of B it owns\n    std::vector<double> B(nLocal * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double value = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        const size_t row = i / n;\n        if (row % P == me) {\n            B[(row / P) * n + i % n] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for owned rows, with every block of B passing by this rank\n    local.assign(nLocal * n, 0.0);\n    forEachRowBlock(B, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* bi = &B[t * n];\n            double* ai = &local[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const double* bj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                ai[static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P] = sum;\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        local[t * n + layout.globalRow(t)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    // Compare owned rows of L * L^T with the original matrix, with every block of L passing by\n    forEachRowBlock(L, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* li = &L[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P;\n                const double* lj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += li[k] * lj[k];\n                }\n\n                const double orig = A_orig[t * n + j];\n                const double error = fabs(sum - orig);\n                maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n                const double rel = error / (fabs(orig) + 1e-10);\n                relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    double localErrors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    double globalErrors[2];\n    MPI_Allreduce(localErrors, globalErrors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    maxError = globalErrors[0];\n    relError = globalErrors[1];\n\n    if (layout.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (layout.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather all rows into one row-major matrix on rank 0 (empty on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherRows(const std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const int P = layout.size;\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    int total = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(r) * n);\n        displs[r] = total;\n        total += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(layout.rank == 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(total) : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(local.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (layout.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const size_t owner = i % P;\n        const size_t t = i / P;\n        std::copy_n(packed.begin() + displs[owner] + t * n, n, full.begin() + i * n);\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    const RowLayout layout{rank, size, n};\n\n    // Allocate local rows\n    std::vector<double> A(layout.localRows() * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, layout, comm);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    const bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, layout, comm);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double elapsed = 0.0; Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? That is the same fused\n// multiply-add the compiler applies to a plain `sum += a * b` under -march=native, so the\n// results match the sequential code and do not depend on which loop path a row takes.\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(rowj[k], rowj[k], sum);\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 = std::fma(r0[k], p, s0);\n                s1 = std::fma(r1[k], p, s1);\n                s2 = std::fma(r2[k], p, s2);\n                s3 = std::fma(r3[k], p, s3);\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? (n - r - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    size_t localRows() const { return rowsOn(rank); }\n    // Global index of local row t\n    size_t globalRow(size_t t) const { return static_cast<size_t>(rank) + t * size; }\n};\n\n// Calls visit(block, src, count) once for the rows of every rank. The block holds the\n// `count` rows owned by rank `src`, row-major. Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Every dot product below accumulates with std::fma. That is the same fused\n// multiply-add the compiler applies to a plain `sum += a * b` under -march=native, so the\n// results match the sequential code and do not depend on which loop path a row takes.\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. For column j, the owner of row j finishes\n// L[j][j] and broadcasts row j of L; every rank then updates its own rows below the\n// diagonal. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(rowj[k], rowj[k], sum);\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 = std::fma(r0[k], p, s0);\n                s1 = std::fma(r1[k], p, s1);\n                s2 = std::fma(r2[k], p, s2);\n                s3 = std::fma(r3[k], p, s3);\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            double* row = &local[t * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(row[k], pivot[k], sum);\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / ljj;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        double* row = &local[t * n];\n        for (size_t j = layout.globalRow(t) + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix, distributed by rows\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    // Every rank walks the same random sequence but keeps only the rows of B it owns\n    std::vector<double> B(nLocal * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double value = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        const size_t row = i / n;\n        if (row % P == me) {\n            B[(row / P) * n + i % n] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for owned rows, with every block of B passing by this rank\n    local.assign(nLocal * n, 0.0);\n    forEachRowBlock(B, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* bi = &B[t * n];\n            double* ai = &local[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const double* bj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum = std::fma(bi[k], bj[k], sum);\n                }\n                ai[static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P] = sum;\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        local[t * n + layout.globalRow(t)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    // Compare owned rows of L * L^T with the original matrix, with every block of L passing by\n    forEachRowBlock(L, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* li = &L[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P;\n                const double* lj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum = std::fma(li[k], lj[k], sum);\n                }\n\n                const double orig = A_orig[t * n + j];\n                const double error = fabs(sum - orig);\n                maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n                const double rel = error / (fabs(orig) + 1e-10);\n                relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    double localErrors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    double globalErrors[2];\n    MPI_Allreduce(localErrors, globalErrors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    maxError = globalErrors[0];\n    relError = globalErrors[1];\n\n    if (layout.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (layout.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather all rows into one row-major matrix on rank 0 (empty on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherRows(const std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const int P = layout.size;\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    int total = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(r) * n);\n        displs[r] = total;\n        total += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(layout.rank == 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(total) : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(local.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (layout.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const size_t owner = i % P;\n        const size_t t = i / P;\n        std::copy_n(packed.begin() + displs[owner] + t * n, n, full.begin() + i * n);\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    const RowLayout layout{rank, size, n};\n\n    // Allocate local rows\n    std::vector<double> A(layout.localRows() * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, layout, comm);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    const bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, layout, comm);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double elapsed = 0.0;  // The slowest rank determines the time\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const long ms = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", ms);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (ms / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        const std::vector<double> L = gatherRows(A, layout, comm);\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            print_results(L, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        const bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, layout, comm);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", valid ? \"PASSED\" : \"FAILED\");\n        }\n        return valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int status = run(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":59,"oldLines":9,"newStart":59,"newLines":9,"lines":["     }"," }"," ","-// Every dot product below accumulates with std::fma. Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Floating-point contraction is disabled for this target (see CMakeLists.txt), so every\n// `sum += a * b` below rounds the product and the sum separately. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(rowj[k], rowj[k], sum);  // fused, as in the sequential code\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? (n - r - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    size_t localRows() const { return rowsOn(rank); }\n    // Global index of local row t\n    size_t globalRow(size_t t) const { return static_cast<size_t>(rank) + t * size; }\n};\n\n// Calls visit(block, src, count) once for the rows of every rank. The block holds the\n// `count` rows owned by rank `src`, row-major. Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Floating-point contraction is disabled for this target (see CMakeLists.txt), so every\n// `sum += a * b` below rounds the product and the sum separately. The diagonal sum is the\n// exception: the sequential code's fused multiply-add there is reproduced with std::fma.\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. For column j, the owner of row j finishes\n// L[j][j] and broadcasts row j of L; every rank then updates its own rows below the\n// diagonal. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(rowj[k], rowj[k], sum);  // fused, as in the sequential code\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            double* row = &local[t * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / ljj;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        double* row = &local[t * n];\n        for (size_t j = layout.globalRow(t) + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix, distributed by rows\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    // Every rank walks the same random sequence but keeps only the rows of B it owns\n    std::vector<double> B(nLocal * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double value = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        const size_t row = i / n;\n        if (row % P == me) {\n            B[(row / P) * n + i % n] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for owned rows, with every block of B passing by this rank\n    local.assign(nLocal * n, 0.0);\n    forEachRowBlock(B, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* bi = &B[t * n];\n            double* ai = &local[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const double* bj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                ai[static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P] = sum;\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        local[t * n + layout.globalRow(t)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    // Compare owned rows of L * L^T with the original matrix, with every block of L passing by\n    forEachRowBlock(L, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* li = &L[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P;\n                const double* lj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum = std::fma(li[k], lj[k], sum);\n                }\n\n                const double orig = A_orig[t * n + j];\n                const double error = fabs(sum - orig);\n                maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n                const double rel = error / (fabs(orig) + 1e-10);\n                relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    double localErrors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    double globalErrors[2];\n    MPI_Allreduce(localErrors, globalErrors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    maxError = globalErrors[0];\n    relError = globalErrors[1];\n\n    if (layout.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (layout.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather all rows into one row-major matrix on rank 0 (empty on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherRows(const std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const int P = layout.size;\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    int total = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(r) * n);\n        displs[r] = total;\n        total += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(layout.rank == 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(total) : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(local.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (layout.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const size_t owner = i % P;\n        const size_t t = i / P;\n        std::copy_n(packed.begin() + displs[owner] + t * n, n, full.begin() + i * n);\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    const RowLayout layout{rank, size, n};\n\n    // Allocate local rows\n    std::vector<double> A(layout.localRows() * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, layout, comm);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    const bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, layout, comm);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double elapsed = 0.0;  // The slowest rank determines the time\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const long ms = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", ms);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (ms / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        const std::vector<double> L = gatherRows(A, layout, comm);\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            print_results(L, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        const bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, layout, comm);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", valid ? \"PASSED\" : \"FAILED\");\n        }\n        return valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int status = run(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":214,"oldLines":7,"newStart":214,"newLines":7,"lines":["                 const double* lj = block + u * n;","                 double sum = 0.0;","                 for (size_t k = 0; The diagonal sum is the\n// exception: the sequential code's fused multiply-add there is reproduced with std::fma.\n\n// Column-oriented","newString":"// Column-oriented","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition (MPI, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Rows are distributed cyclically: global row i is owned by rank i % size and is\n// stored locally as row i / size. Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? (n - r - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    size_t localRows() const { return rowsOn(rank); }\n    // Global index of local row t\n    size_t globalRow(size_t t) const { return static_cast<size_t>(rank) + t * size; }\n};\n\n// Calls visit(block, src, count) once for the rows of every rank. The block holds the\n// `count` rows owned by rank `src`, row-major. Blocks circulate around a ring, so each\n// rank only ever holds two blocks at a time.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachRowBlock(const std::vector<double>& mine, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm, Visit visit) {\n    const int P = layout.size;\n    const int next = (layout.rank + 1) % P;\n    const int prev = (layout.rank + P - 1) % P;\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> cur(layout.rowsOn(0) * n);  // rank 0 owns the most rows\n    std::vector<double> incoming(cur.size());\n    std::copy(mine.begin(), mine.end(), cur.begin());\n\n    int src = layout.rank;\n    for (int step = 0; step < P; ++step) {\n        visit(cur.data(), src, layout.rowsOn(src));\n        if (step + 1 == P) break;\n\n        const int nextSrc = (src + P - 1) % P;\n        MPI_Sendrecv(cur.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(src) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, next, 0,\n                     incoming.data(), static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(nextSrc) * n), MPI_DOUBLE, prev, 0,\n                     comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        std::swap(cur, incoming);\n        src = nextSrc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Floating-point contraction is disabled for this target (see CMakeLists.txt), so every\n// `sum += a * b` below rounds the product and the sum separately. The diagonal sum is the\n// exception: the sequential code's fused multiply-add there is reproduced with std::fma.\n\n// Column-oriented distributed factorization. For column j, the owner of row j finishes\n// L[j][j] and broadcasts row j of L; every rank then updates its own rows below the\n// diagonal. Each entry is computed with the same operations in the same order as the\n// sequential row-wise algorithm, so the factor is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n);  // row j of L, up to column j\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        if (me == static_cast<size_t>(owner)) {\n            double* rowj = &local[(j / P) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(rowj[k], rowj[k], sum);  // fused, as in the sequential code\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Non-positive pivot is broadcast as-is and signals failure to every rank\n                pivot[j] = val;\n            } else {\n                pivot[j] = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = pivot[j];\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, comm);\n        if (pivot[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (me == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Update owned rows below the diagonal:\n        // L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n        const double ljj = pivot[j];\n        // First local row whose global index exceeds j\n        size_t t = j >= me ? (j - me) / P + 1 : 0;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide floating-point add latency,\n        // and each row's sum still accumulates in ascending k order\n        for (; t + 4 <= nLocal; t += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &local[t * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / ljj;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / ljj;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / ljj;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / ljj;\n        }\n        for (; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            double* row = &local[t * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / ljj;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        double* row = &local[t * n];\n        for (size_t j = layout.globalRow(t) + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix, distributed by rows\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t me = layout.rank;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    // Every rank walks the same random sequence but keeps only the rows of B it owns\n    std::vector<double> B(nLocal * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double value = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        const size_t row = i / n;\n        if (row % P == me) {\n            B[(row / P) * n + i % n] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for owned rows, with every block of B passing by this rank\n    local.assign(nLocal * n, 0.0);\n    forEachRowBlock(B, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* bi = &B[t * n];\n            double* ai = &local[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const double* bj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                ai[static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P] = sum;\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n        local[t * n + layout.globalRow(t)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const size_t P = layout.size;\n    const size_t nLocal = layout.localRows();\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    // Compare owned rows of L * L^T with the original matrix, with every block of L passing by\n    forEachRowBlock(L, layout, comm, [&](const double* block, int src, size_t count) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nLocal; ++t) {\n            const double* li = &L[t * n];\n            for (size_t u = 0; u < count; ++u) {\n                const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(src) + u * P;\n                const double* lj = block + u * n;\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += li[k] * lj[k];\n                }\n\n                const double orig = A_orig[t * n + j];\n                const double error = fabs(sum - orig);\n                maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n                const double rel = error / (fabs(orig) + 1e-10);\n                relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    double localErrors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    double globalErrors[2];\n    MPI_Allreduce(localErrors, globalErrors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    maxError = globalErrors[0];\n    relError = globalErrors[1];\n\n    if (layout.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (layout.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather all rows into one row-major matrix on rank 0 (empty on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherRows(const std::vector<double>& local, const RowLayout& layout, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = layout.n;\n    const int P = layout.size;\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    int total = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(layout.rowsOn(r) * n);\n        displs[r] = total;\n        total += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(layout.rank == 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(total) : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(local.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (layout.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; Cyclic ownership spreads the triangular workload\n// evenly across ranks. Each rank stores its rows contiguously in row-major order.\n\nstruct RowLayout {\n    int rank;\n    int size;\n    size_t n;\n\n    // Number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowsOn(int r) const {\n        return n > static_cast<size_t>(r) ? (n - r - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    size_t localRows() const { return rowsOn(rank); }\n    // Global index of local row t\n    size_t globalRow(size_t t) const { return static_cast<size_t>(rank) + t * size; }\n};\n\n// Calls visit(block, src, count) once for the rows of every rank.
